# `matter/transcoding/MatterPhaseRuntimeCoordinator.js`

> **Source:** `engine/matter/transcoding/MatterPhaseRuntimeCoordinator.js`

Region-scoped atomic coordination for phase, packet, fluid, and bond state.

## Classes

### `class MatterPhaseRuntimeInterruptedError extends Error`

Recoverable fault injected between two cross-domain commit stages.

### `class MatterPhaseRuntimeCoordinator`

Owns the cross-domain transaction boundary for one canonical Matter region. The supplied codec and topology remain caller-owned; the coordinator owns its phase journal and fluid projection and never submits GPU work itself.

### `createMatterPhaseRuntimeCoordinator(options)`
